RF_Thunderbreak_Command.text: Thunderbreak command — a broad, disciplined heavy-cruiser bridge organized around a central command position, active tactical and navigation stations, large shared operational displays, and visible evidence of an older ship repeatedly repaired rather than cosmetically renewed. Crew movement should preserve clear station geography across returns.

RF_Admiralty_Tribunal.text: Fleet Admiralty tribunal — formal Core hearing space built to make hierarchy legible: elevated circular authority positions, a lower testimony floor, controlled evidence displays, restrained stone-metal geometry, and very little visual clutter. Evidence that disrupts institutional neatness should remain physically visible once introduced.

RF_Relic_Court.text: Relic Court — monumental Core political chamber with bright stone, restrained banners, long sightlines, a central working table for documents and live operational feeds, and enough open floor that who joins or refuses the table is visually meaningful.

RF_Auric_Civic_Core.text: Auric civic and operations complex — practical Verge government space embedded in a working freeport: scuffed tables, cargo and ration boards, public-facing displays, doors opening toward active docks, and officials working close to clerks, residents and freight rather than behind ceremonial barriers.

RF_Auric_Luxury_Ring.text: Auric luxury ring / Crown Ring — formerly expensive residential concourse converted into unstable public shelter: chandeliers and high-end finishes coexist with bedding, heaters, ration lines, temporary partitions and a large cracked observation window under continuous structural watch.

RF_Veil_Market.text: Veil Market — dense lived-in trade network of stalls, broker rooms, back passages and route boards with practical worklight, handwritten or chalk navigation information, layered signage and enough physical wear that commerce, refuge and rumor visibly share the same infrastructure.

RF_Gravefire_Interior.text: Gravefire interior — compact Shard working ship maintained through visible repair rather than ceremony: tight stations, patched pale industrial surfaces, narrow bright-red faction markings, restrained lighting, and a cockpit/bridge geography that favors practical sightlines over spectacle.

RF_Arena_Vault.text: Shardfall Arena Vault — vast circular Shard political chamber of pale industrial structure, bright-red control markings and dark forge-adjacent depth. Empty tiers and tactical displays should make absence of public support as visible as a crowd would be; the three Triarch masks occupy distinct, repeatable positions.

RF_Tal_Corvus_Warrens.text: Tal Corvus warrens — dense inhabited industrial passages carved through damp, worn infrastructure: narrow routes, practical heat and supply hardware, improvised chalk guidance, layered family habitation and recurring seams where anomaly seep can become visible without turning the space mystical.

RF_Shatterforge.text: Shatterforge — enormous inhabited forge complex where ember furnaces, vent trunks, exposed bridges, blade-production halls and family quarters occupy the same vertical industrial system. Safety hardware and service vents must retain readable geography because later damage depends on where they connect.

RF_Auric_Gate.text: Auric Gate — large reciprocal-field transit installation of ember-orange pylons, stability rims, shared timing boards and civilian approach lanes. Preserve the relationship between pylons, central crossing lane, traffic-control positions and shield approaches so battle and later Accord operations read as the same place.
